COMMUNITY INTELLIGENCE · IST

TG Groups admins

Your communities. The people behind them. Admins, roles and titles in one place.

Minimum time between messages from the same account.

Automatic collection · new groups only

Collect visible admins from new groups. Previous groups stay excluded.

How collection & archiving works

Connect an account, wait for “Watching for new groups”, then join your next group in Telegram. Existing groups are recorded privately as an exclusion list; their admins are not imported.

Only admins Telegram makes visible to your selected account can be saved. Bot admins are excluded. CEO, CTO and similar titles are shown exactly as provided by the group; missing fields stay blank. After admin records are saved, the group is moved to Telegram Archive in the same account. If no admins are visible, the group stays in your main chats. Archiving keeps your group membership.

ALL YOUR MESSAGES IN ONE PLACE

Message templates 4 types · 5 options each

Add up to five options per message type. Every filled option is used once in a shuffled cycle before repeating. Identical options count as one.

Same Telegram account throughout. Replies and follow-ups stay with the account that sent the first message. If it is unavailable, sending waits for that account.

The three-day follow-up uses template 2, at 10:00 in the contact’s timezone. Unknown or ambiguous timezones wait for your selection. It checks replies before sending and stops after a reply or a confirmed follow-up. Pausing a lead’s follow-up reminders also pauses its automatic follow-up. Your gateway must remain online.

1. Initial message2. Three-day follow-up3. Yes reply · pitch4. Yes reply · call invitation

1. Initial message

Sent when you start a conversation.

2. Three-day follow-up

Automatic: the first 10:00 local slot after 72 hours without a reply. Messages are spaced within 10:00–11:00 and missed windows wait until the next day. Unknown timezones wait for your selection. Uses the original sender. Also available for manual Send now.

3. Yes reply · pitch

First message after a clear yes, yeah or yeh. Uses the recipient, token and selected exchange.

4. Yes reply · call invitation

Sent separately after the pitch, once, from the same Telegram account. Automation then stops for this contact.

Each type has five slots. Fill the options you want to use; at least one option per type is required. Save changes to use them.

@username uses the recipient’s public handle or display name. $TOKEN and @TOKEN use your selected $ticker. {{exchange}} uses the exchange you chose. Existing delivery history is preserved. Affirmative reply templates are captured when a contact is enabled; the scheduled follow-up randomly chooses from its own saved options when it is prepared to send. Once chosen, delays and retries keep the same text.

YOUR CONNECTIONS & CONTROLS

Settings

Manage Telegram accounts, login and messages waiting to send.

Telegram accounts

Telegram API credentials

Get the matching API ID and API Hash from your app at my.telegram.org/apps.

Connect your Telegram account

Or connect with QR from Telegram → Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device.

Disconnecting does not clear your saved records or usage. Telegram chooses the code delivery method.

Sending queue

Messages keep their reviewed text and selected account. Closing this tab does not stop the server queue.

Keep your records

Use a persistent DATA_DIR on your server to preserve Telegram sessions, admin records, templates and queued sends across redeployments. Delays and daily limits do not guarantee that Telegram will allow a message.

Conversation

View conversation history

The server must stay online. Missed schedules wait for review. Free-host restarts or deployments can clear scheduled jobs.
